name: compact-adviser
description: Suggests (or, opt-in, runs) /compact at a completed checkpoint, judged by TypeSafe Jev. Its hooks module activates only when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is exactly 1 and is otherwise a complete no-op.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: hint shows advice; auto compacts at eligible checkpoints after a first-use confirmation from /compact-adviser; off disables the adviser (Claude Code's own auto-compact is unaffected).

minContextTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minContextTokens.description: A constant token count, not a percentage; no judgment below it.

logRequests.title: Log TypeSafe requests
logRequests.description: When on, each TypeSafe/Jev request and sanitized Jev outcome is appended to ~/.claude/compact-adviser-requests-<session-id>.jsonl. Off by default. Never logs the API key.

profile.title: Judge profile JSON
profile.description: Optional version-1 judge profile JSON. Empty uses shipped defaults. Invalid profiles disable advice. This does not grant auto consent.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Saved from /compact-adviser. Hidden in /config so the value is never shown. A non-empty TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the launch environment wins. Do not commit this value.
